games.title: OVERDRIVE
games.tagline: Midnight street racing in 80s wedge-era supercars.
games.about: Four original period cars, a six-event street career, a live radio dial and online races with friends. Tune your car, buy paint and wheels with street cash, and race the city at night.

games.title: Ghost Hunters TV
games.tagline: A silly ghost-hunting TV show you play with friends.
games.about: One friend films, the rest host, and one friend can be the ghost. Edith the diva, Poltergeist Pete, Sir Clanksalot and Gloop are all waiting to be caught on camera.

games.title: Gore Lab VR
games.tagline: A physics sandbox. Grab a weapon and take the dummies apart.
games.about: A test lab full of weapons and crash-test dummies with real physics bodies. Built for Meta Quest, playable on PC with mouse and keyboard.

games.title: BRUTALIST VR
games.tagline: A stickman physics sandbox. Swing with weight, cut anything.
games.about: Heavy weapons, floppy stickmen and walls to paint. A work in progress.

games.title: INFILTRATE
games.tagline: Slip into a black site at night and get out alive.
games.about: A tactical stealth game: silenced weapons, real reloads and guards that hunt you. Take out two targets, steal their intel and get back to the van before the alarm goes up.

games.title: Jason's Revenge
games.tagline: Friday the 13th at Camp Crystal Lake. You are Jason.
games.about: The counselors are back. Cut the phone line, wreck their car and kill the power before anyone calls for help.

games.title: HALLOWEENVR
games.tagline: Haddonfield, October 31, 1978. You are Michael Myers.
games.about: Stalk the quiet streets of Haddonfield on Halloween night. VR on Quest, or WASD and mouse on PC.

games.title: MANHUNT VR
games.tagline: Carcer City. Every hunter in the district wants you dead.
games.about: You are James Earl Cash. Stay in the shadows, keep quiet, and survive the Director's night.
games.news: Executions menu item; cache tags v46

games.title: AsylumVR
games.tagline: Mount Harrow State Asylum. Run. Hide. Record.
games.about: You are a journalist with a camcorder and you cannot fight. Hide in lockers and under beds, and use night vision to see in the dark. It eats batteries.
games.news: v39: prerecorded title themes and menu sounds

games.title: POSTAL 2 VR
games.tagline: A little janky, a lot of chaos.
games.about: Run errands in a town that has had enough of you.
games.news: Load correctly in the flat deployed layout

games.title: Granny VR
games.tagline: Get out of Granny's house before she finds you.
games.about: Sneak through a creaky house, find the keys and escape. Every noise you make, she hears.
